entries.anchor: Step 4b: Reachability Check (REQUIRED before planning any new state/flow)
entries.rationale: The prod_data_access default said escalate when no production access exists while the decision rule said no prod access means N/A and proceed; runs could pick either outcome (ai-dossier#1216 open question). Cases A-D are now exclusive and ordered, the none opt-out is matched exactly, and an uncountable trigger is unverifiable rather than 0 occurrences.
